default.question: Is this app free to use?
default.answer: Yes, there is a comprehensive free tier available for all new users. Premium features can be unlocked via the Pro subscription.

default.question: How does the 30-day money back guarantee work?
default.answer: If you're not completely satisfied with our service within the first 30 days, simply contact our support team to receive a full refund, no questions asked.

default.question: What platforms do you support?
default.answer: Our application is fully supported on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and modern web browsers.

default.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
default.answer: Absolutely. You can cancel or pause your membership directly from your account dashboard with zero hidden fees.
